attchmntText: Sakthi Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sakthi Sugars Limited has published its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30.9.2026. The publication was released on 12.11.2026 in the Financial Express and Dinamani newspapers. This filing is pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company submitted copies of these publications to BSE Limited and The National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The scrip codes are BSE 507315 and NSE SAKHTISUG. The letter was signed by S. Venkatesh, Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Sakthi Sugars Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sakthi Sugars Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30.9.2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 11.11.2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 36351.14 lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 2963.97 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 2.63. For the half year ended 30.9.2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 47069.30 lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 2844.19 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.63. The statutory auditors, M/s. P.N.Raghavendra Rao & Co., issued a limited review report. The company has no subsidiaries. Consolidated financial results are not applicable.

attchmntText: Sakthi Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Reconciliation of Share capital Audit Report'.
